इधरफेंको

Translation status: हिन्दी reader-locale proof. Term names and code fences follow the hi pack; supporting prose may still be English.

Throws a recoverable error.

Syntax: इधरफेंको <expression>

Category#

errors

Related#

  • पकड़ो
  • मरोजाओ
  • यदि
  • ⇥

Examples#

radix/corpus/iace/iace-si-guard.fab (canonical · keyword)#

Conditional throw with यदि guard.

# =============================================================================
# इधरफेंको — Conditional throw with यदि guard
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • Conditional throw with यदि guard.
#   • Related keywords: पकड़ो, मरोजाओ, यदि, ⇥
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • Using `इधरफेंको यदि` without a `⇥` on the enclosing function or a `करो/cape` wrapper — the guard sugar expands to `यदि cond { इधरफेंको val }`, which still needs an error context.
#
# See also: पकड़ो, मरोजाओ, यदि, ⇥
# =============================================================================

# इधरफेंको with optional यदि guard
#
# इधरफेंको <value> [यदि <condicio>]
#
# GRAMMAR:
#   throwStmt :← 'इधरफेंको' expr ['यदि' expr]
#
# The optional `यदि` guard is parser sugar:
#   इधरफेंको val यदि cond  →  यदि cond { इधरफेंको val }
#
# Without the guard, इधरफेंको is unconditional (unchanged).
#
# EXPECTED OUTPUT:
#   "ok: valid input"
#   "caught: empty input"
#   "caught: negative"

fn validata(string input) → string ⇥ string {
    # Guard: throw if input is empty
    throw "empty input" if input.length() ≡ 0

    return "valid: §"(input)
}

main {
    # Happy path — guard not triggered
    do {
        const string a ← validata("hello")
        print "ok: §"(a)
    }
    catch err {
        print "unexpected: §"(err)
    }

    # Empty input — इधरफेंको यदि guard triggers
    do {
        const string b ← validata("")
        print "should not reach"
    }
    catch err {
        print "caught: §"(err)
    }

    # इधरफेंको with यदि on same line
    do {
        throw "force throw" if true
        print "should not reach"
    }
    catch err {
        print "caught: §"(err)
    }
}

radix/corpus/iace/iace.fab (canonical · keyword)#

Throws a recoverable error.

# =============================================================================
# इधरफेंको — Throws a recoverable error
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • Throws a recoverable error.
#   • Related keywords: ⇥, पकड़ो, मरोजाओ, लौटाओ
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • Using `इधरफेंको` without a `⇥` on the enclosing function or a `करो { ... } पकड़ो err { ... }` wrapper — `इधरफेंको` requires an error-handling context (SEM010).
#
# See also: ⇥, पकड़ो, मरोजाओ, लौटाओ
# =============================================================================

# इधरफेंको — recoverable throw and पकड़ो handler
#
# इधरफेंको <value>
# करो { <body> }
# पकड़ो err { <handler> }
#
# GRAMMAR:
#   throwStmt :← 'इधरफेंको' expr
#   facStmt   :← 'करो' block catchClause?
#
# EXPECTED OUTPUT:
#   Caught error messages from करो/cape recovery paths.
#
# BACKEND:
#   Rust/Go lowering does not emit इधरफेंको/cape yet — compile-only smoke.

main {
    # Bare इधरफेंको with पाठ payload
    do {
        throw "Something went wrong"
    }
    catch err {
        print "Caught:", err
    }

    # इधरफेंको with interpolated message
    const int code ← 404
    do {
        throw "Error code: §"(code)
    }
    catch err {
        print "Caught:", err
    }

    # Conditional इधरफेंको inside करो — validation guard
    const int value ← -5
    do {
        if value ≺ 0 {
            throw "Value must be non-negative"
        }
        print "Value is valid"
    }
    catch err {
        print "Validation failed:", err
    }
}

Expected output:

Caught: Something went wrong
Caught: Error code: 404
Validation failed: Value must be non-negative
